level.theme: Mysterious, eerie, and filled with ancient secrets waiting to be uncovered
level.setting: An ancient submerged city hidden beneath the ocean floor, filled with strange bioluminescent flora and ancient ruins
level.player_weapon: Tectonic Staff (can manipulate stone and earth)

enemy.name: Tentacle Guardian
enemy.weakness: Coral Shards

pickup.name: Obsidian Lens
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Obsidian Lens

encounters.trigger: The Tentacle Guardian's defeat triggers a hidden passage that leads to the next encounter

enemy.name: Coral Serpent
enemy.weakness: Coral Shards (from prior pickup)

pickup.name: Coral Shards
pickup.effect: Increases geomancer's stone-based attack power by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Coral Serpent awakens the ancient seal beneath the seabed, revealing the final chamber

enemy.name: Leviathan Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Coral Shards (from prior pickup)

pickup.name: Seal of the Deep
pickup.effect: Reveals the location of the Tidewarden

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Leviathan Sentinel removes the final barrier between the player and the Tidewarden

boss.name: The Tidewarden
boss.weakness: Obsidian Lens (acquired from the first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Tidewarden by targeting its core with the Obsidian Lens

level.objective: Uncover the mystery of the Tidewarden and defeat it to unlock the path to the surface
level.reward: Chest containing a rare artifact: the Heart of the Abyss

level.theme: Exploration and discovery, with a calming and immersive underwater atmosphere.
level.setting: Serene underwater world filled with glowing coral, schools of fish, and bioluminescent flora. The environment feels peaceful, but dangers lurk in the deep.

enemy.name: Shadowfin Eel
enemy.weakness: Coral Spike

pickup.name: Coral Spike
pickup.effect: Unlocks the 'Coral Spike' weapon

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Shadowfin Eel to unlock the Coral Spike, which will be essential for the final boss fight.

enemy.name: Glowfin Shark
enemy.weakness: Coral Spike

encounters.hazard: Bioluminescent Bubbles (can disorient the player for 2 seconds)

pickup.name: Ancient Pearl
pickup.effect: Replenishes 50% of the player's health and energy

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Glowfin Shark will allow you to reach the final chamber where the Leviathan awaits.

enemy.name: Tideborn Guardian
enemy.weakness: Coral Spike

pickup.name: Leviathan's Roar
pickup.effect: Unlocks the 'Leviathan's Roar' ability

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Tideborn Guardian to reveal the path to the final boss, the Tideborn Leviathan.

boss.name: Tideborn Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan using the 'Coral Spike' weapon

level.objective: Navigate through the underwater realm, defeat the enemies, unlock the Coral Spike weapon, and defeat the Tideborn Leviathan.
level.reward: Access to the next level: 'The Abyssal Expanse'

level.theme: A journey through the drowned halls of the dead, where every step echoes with the whispers of the lost, and the ocean itself seems to breathe with the weight of ancient, unforgiving power.
level.setting: A drowned ancient kingdom with overgrown ruins, glowing bioluminescent flora, and spectral remnants of a lost civilization. The water is dark and thick with mist, and the silence is broken only by the distant echoes of the dead.

enemy.name: Mournfang (Ghostly Serpent)
enemy.weakness: The player's primary weapon: the *Soulbrand Harpoon*

encounters.hazard: Darkwater current that slows movement and reduces sight

pickup.name: Soulbrand Harpoon
pickup.effect: Grants the player the *Soulbrand Harpoon* (increased damage against undead and spectral foes)

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating Mournfang, a sealed gate opens, revealing the path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Wraithkelp (Cursed Plant)
enemy.weakness: The *Resonant Heart* (a pickup obtained from the first encounter's gate)

encounters.hazard: Cursed kelp that grows rapidly and entangles the player, reducing movement speed and stamina

pickup.name: Resonant Heart
pickup.effect: The *Resonant Heart* (emits a pulse that disrupts the energy of enemies, revealing their weak points and dealing AoE damage)

encounters.trigger: After destroying the Wraithkelp, the ground begins to crack, revealing a glowing chamber — the lair of the final boss.

enemy.name: The Abyssal Sovereign
enemy.weakness: The *Resonant Heart* (the pickup obtained from the second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling, toxic gas pockets, and shifting terrain

pickup.name: Echo of the Necromancer
pickup.effect: The player gains the *Echo of the Necromancer*, a permanent ability to summon a ghostly guardian for short bursts

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Sovereign, the chamber collapses, revealing a new path to deeper, uncharted waters.

boss.name: The Abyssal Sovereign
boss.weakness: The Resonant Heart (a pickup from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core of the Sovereign’s body

level.objective: Navigate through the ruins of an ancient civilization beneath the sea, uncovering the secrets of the dead while fending off spectral enemies and the final, ominous boss.
level.reward: The *Echo of the Necromancer* ability, granting access to deeper and more dangerous underwater tombs.

level.theme: Tense exploration and combat in a claustrophobic, crumbling underwater environment with high stakes and limited resources.
level.setting: A labyrinth of ancient coral ruins, dark and silent, with only the faint glow of bioluminescent life and the distant roar of the Leviathan echoing through the depths.

enemy.name: Tentacle Horror
enemy.weakness: Electroclaw (the player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Currents that pull the player toward the enemy

pickup.name: Storm Relic
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new ability: 'Storm Surge' which creates a temporary shockwave

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Tentacle Horror triggers the release of a bioluminescent beacon that illuminates a hidden path forward, leading to the second encounter.

enemy.name: Hydro Warden
enemy.weakness: Storm Relic (from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Toxic water spores that reduce the player's stamina

pickup.name: Coral Armor
pickup.effect: Provides a temporary shield against elemental damage

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Hydro Warden, the shield from the Coral Armor is needed to survive the collapsing ceiling in the next area, leading to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Maelstrom Warden
enemy.weakness: Electroclaw (the player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Strong whirlpools that hinder movement and reduce attack speed

pickup.name: Tidal Core
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants resistance to electricity

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Maelstrom Warden releases the Tidal Core, which is required to weaken the boss.

boss.name: The Abyssal Leviathan
boss.weakness: Tidal Core (a pickup acquired in Encounter 3)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting its weakness to the Tidal Core

level.objective: Navigate through collapsing underwater ruins, defeat three enemies, and use the Tidal Core to defeat the Abyssal Leviathan.
level.reward: Unlocks the ability 'Storm Tempest' — a powerful area-of-effect lightning attack that scales with the player's level

level.theme: Eerie exploration with stealth and strategy elements, emphasizing environmental hazards and resource management.
level.setting: A decaying underwater city, shrouded in fog, with flickering lights and strange, whispering echoes. The water is cold, dark, and filled with unknown creatures.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblade - a fast, stealth-based sword with a charge attack.

enemy.name: Shadow Eel
enemy.weakness: The Shadow Eel is vulnerable to the player's weapon if it's charged for at least 3 seconds.

encounters.hazard: A sudden drop in oxygen levels forces the player to fight quickly or risk suffocation.

pickup.name: Eel's Charge Enhancer
pickup.effect: Increases weapon charge speed by 20%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shadow Eel, a hidden path opens to the second encounter.

enemy.name: Phantom Tendril
enemy.weakness: The Phantoms are vulnerable to the 'Eel's Charge Enhancer' pickup.

encounters.hazard: The area is filled with corrosive water that deals 10 damage per second.

pickup.name: Veil of Shadows
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invisibility for 5 seconds upon use.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Phantom Tendril, the player finds a sealed chamber leading to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Crystallized Leviathan
enemy.weakness: The Leviathan's crystalline armor can be cracked by the 'Veil of Shadows' pickup.

encounters.hazard: The Leviathan's presence destabilizes the environment, causing periodic structural collapses.

pickup.name: Crystallized Energy Core
pickup.effect: Restores full health and grants a shield for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Leviathan, a path opens to the final boss fight with The Abyssal Warden.

boss.name: The Abyssal Warden
boss.weakness: The Warden's energy core is vulnerable to direct impact from the 'Crystallized Energy Core' pickup.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core embedded in its chest by using the 'Crystallized Energy Core' obtained from the third encounter.

level.objective: Navigate the eerie underwater ruins and defeat the final boss, The Abyssal Warden, by using the pickups acquired during the encounters.
level.reward: Access to the 'Oceanic Dominion' zone, a new underwater map with more challenges and treasures.

level.theme: Chaotic, volatile, and visually intense with frequent environmental hazards, flickering lights, and sudden seismic events that disrupt the player's movement and combat flow.
level.setting: The level takes place in the Abyssal Expanse, a deep, volatile underwater zone with unstable geology, glowing vents, and chaotic currents that constantly shift the environment.
level.player_weapon: Flame Whip – A long-range fire-based weapon that can ignite enemies and set the environment on fire.

enemy.name: Thermal Crawler
enemy.weakness: The Thermal Crawler is weak to cold-based attacks, which can be obtained from a pickup in the second encounter.

encounters.hazard: The player must navigate through a collapsing coral maze filled with steam vents that can scald them for 5 seconds on contact.

pickup.name: Frost Grenade
pickup.effect: Provides a 'Frost Grenade' that can freeze enemies in place for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Thermal Crawler, the floor collapses, leading the player into a deeper trench where the second encounter begins.

enemy.name: Electro Ray
enemy.weakness: The Electro Ray is weak to fire-based attacks, which can be enhanced using a pickup obtained in the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: The player is surrounded by electrical currents that deal damage over time and disrupt the player's pyromancy abilities temporarily.

pickup.name: Pyro Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases the player's fire-based damage by 25% and allows the pyromancer to ignite flammable objects in the environment.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Electro Ray, a deep rumble shakes the trench, revealing the entrance to the final chamber where the boss awaits.

enemy.name: Tidal Hydra
enemy.weakness: The Tidal Hydra is weak to fire-based attacks, which can be enhanced with the 'Pyro Catalyst' pickup obtained in the second encounter.

encounters.hazard: The player must fight the Tidal Hydra while dealing with rising water levels that reduce visibility and restrict movement.

pickup.name: Reflective Shield
pickup.effect: Provides a temporary shield that reflects enemy attacks back at them for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Tidal Hydra causes a massive explosion that opens a hidden passage to the Leviathan Core.

boss.name: Leviathan Core
boss.weakness: The Leviathan Core is vulnerable to heat-based attacks when the 'Pyro Catalyst' is active in the player's inventory.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan Core by triggering a thermal overload on its core reactor using the 'Pyro Catalyst' pickup.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic underwater environment, defeat three enemies with increasing difficulty, and use the pickups obtained during encounters to finally defeat the Leviathan Core.
level.reward: The player gains access to the 'Thermal Overloader' weapon upgrade, which permanently increases fire-based damage by 30% and allows the pyromancer to detonate fire hazards on command.

level.theme: Desolate, haunting, with flickering lights and eerie echoes of the past.
level.setting: An ancient underwater fortress, long abandoned and now overrun by mutated sea creatures and the corrupted Leviathan Warden.

enemy.name: Tide Crawler
enemy.weakness: The Tide Crawler is weak to the player's primary weapon, the 'Corrosive Warden Lance'. Its exoskeleton corrodes rapidly under its own acidic secretions.

pickup.name: Abyssal Plating
pickup.effect: Increases player armor by 15%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Tide Crawler, the pressure valves on the tunnel walls rupture, releasing a massive plume of bioluminescent algae. This attracts the next encounter.

enemy.name: Mawfin
enemy.weakness: The Mawfin's carapace is weakened by the 'Abyssal Plating' pickup. It absorbs energy from the plating, causing it to degrade the Mawfin's regeneration abilities.

pickup.name: Tidebreaker Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks a temporary 'Tidebreaker Core' energy surge ability

encounters.trigger: As the Mawfin is defeated, the algae bloom collapses inward, creating a vortex that pulls the player toward the final chamber.

enemy.name: Leviathan Warden
enemy.weakness: The Leviathan Warden's armor is vulnerable to the 'Tidebreaker Core' energy surge. Only the core can bypass its regenerative systems.

pickup.name: Warden's Resonance
pickup.effect: Restores 100% player health and armor

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Leviathan Warden, the player discovers the 'Warden's Resonance' which allows them to escape the collapsing ruins.

boss.name: Leviathan Warden
boss.weakness: The Leviathan Warden's armor is vulnerable to the 'Tidebreaker Core' energy surge. Only the core can bypass its regenerative systems.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan Warden with the 'Tidebreaker Core' pickup.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the Leviathan's domain and destroy it to restore stability to the underwater region.
level.reward: Warden's Resonance, which grants a permanent 25% damage increase to the Corrosive Warden Lance.

level.theme: Whimsical illusions and playful enemies that test the player's ability to manipulate perception.
level.setting: A whimsical underwater realm filled with reflective caves, glowing bioluminescent forests, and shifting currents that play tricks on the mind.
level.player_weapon: Illusionary Dagger (can create mirages and distractions)

enemy.name: Mirror Manta
enemy.weakness: The Mirror Manta is vulnerable to the player's illusionary weapon when it's in a reflected form.

encounters.hazard: The water becomes reflective, distorting the player's vision.

pickup.name: Refraction Lens
pickup.effect: Increases illusion power by 10%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Mirror Manta, the reflections begin to move independently, leading the player to the next area.

enemy.name: Ghost Kelp
enemy.weakness: The Ghost Kelp is vulnerable to the 'Refraction Lens' pickup from the previous encounter.

encounters.hazard: The water is thick with bioluminescent algae, causing the player to get disoriented.

pickup.name: Bubble of Illusion
pickup.effect: Allows the player to create a temporary illusionary shield.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Ghost Kelp, the bioluminescent patterns on the kelp begin to form a path leading toward the final area.

enemy.name: Shifting Octopus
enemy.weakness: The Shifting Octopus is vulnerable to the 'Bubble of Illusion' pickup from the previous encounter.

encounters.hazard: The area is filled with shifting currents and floating debris that can impede movement.

pickup.name: Echo Crystal
pickup.effect: Allows the player to summon a temporary echo of themselves to distract enemies.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shifting Octopus, the currents calm and reveal the path to the Phantom Leviathan's lair.

boss.name: The Phantom Leviathan
boss.weakness: The Phantom Leviathan's core is vulnerable to the 'Echo Crystal' that resonates with its illusions.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Phantom Leviathan by damaging its core using the 'Echo Crystal' obtained from the final encounter.

level.objective: Defeat the Phantom Leviathan by navigating through three whimsical underwater encounters, each teaching the player to use illusions more effectively.
level.reward: The player gains access to the 'Hall of Illusions', a special area where they can refine their illusionary powers.

level.theme: Chaotic jungle environment with unpredictable enemy behavior and shifting terrain.
level.setting: A dense, overgrown jungle filled with hidden paths, ancient ruins, and unpredictable hazards.

enemy.name: Swarmfang Viper
enemy.weakness: Stun Trap

pickup.name: Stun Trap
pickup.effect: Stun enemies for 3 turns

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Swarmfang Viper opens a hidden path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Thornclaw Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Fire Tonic

pickup.name: Fire Tonic
pickup.effect: Apply fire damage and reduce enemy armor by 20%

encounters.trigger: After consuming the Fire Tonic, a hidden grove reveals the final path to the Jungle Titan.

enemy.name: The Jungle Titan
enemy.weakness: Storm Totem

pickup.name: Storm Totem
pickup.effect: Summon a storm that disrupts enemy attacks and increases player attack speed

encounters.trigger: The Storm Totem is the only way to break the Jungle Titan's defenses.

boss.name: The Jungle Titan
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Jungle Titan with the Storm Totem in hand

level.objective: Reach the heart of the jungle and defeat the Jungle Titan, using pickups obtained during the journey.
level.reward: Echo of the Jungle, granting 20% damage boost for all jungle encounters

level.theme: Mysterious, foreboding, and filled with ancient secrets waiting to be uncovered by the brave ranger.
level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle filled with mist, towering trees, and ruins hidden beneath the canopy. Strange lights flicker in the distance, and the air hums with unseen energy.

enemy.name: Shadow Stalker
enemy.weakness: Blowdart (from the first pickup)

pickup.name: Blowdart
pickup.effect: Blowdart: deals 20 damage and stuns enemy

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Shadow Stalker to dispel the mist, revealing a path forward

enemy.name: Feathered Serpent
enemy.weakness: Feather of the Sky God (from the second pickup)

pickup.name: Feather of the Sky God
pickup.effect: Feather of the Sky God: grants 50% resistance to falling damage and allows jumping higher

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Feathered Serpent to activate the platform mechanism, leading to the boss arena

enemy.name: Vinebound Warden
enemy.weakness: Spear of the Jungle (from the third pickup)

pickup.name: Spear of the Jungle
pickup.effect: Spear of the Jungle: increased damage against plant-based enemies

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Vinebound Warden to clear the wall of vines, revealing the final path to the boss

boss.name: The Veiled Guardian
boss.weakness: Amulet of the Jaguar - must be equipped in inventory
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the amulet on its chest

level.objective: Navigate through the jungle and defeat the Veiled Guardian, using items acquired in each encounter to overcome its defenses
level.reward: Jungle Relic - grants 10% increased damage against all jungle enemies

level.theme: Survival and stealth in a hostile environment.
level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle filled with overgrown ruins, venomous creatures, and shifting terrain.
level.player_weapon: Rogue's Dagger (base damage: 25, can be upgraded with pickups)

enemy.name: Venomous Python
enemy.weakness: The Python's scales are vulnerable to fire-based attacks.

pickup.name: Ember Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Ember Knife (fire damage, 15 damage per hit, 3 charges)

encounters.trigger: The Python's defeat triggers a sudden tremor that reveals a hidden path deeper into the jungle.

enemy.name: Bloodfeather Harpy
enemy.weakness: The Harpy's wings are vulnerable to the Ember Knife if it's ignited.

pickup.name: Shadow Veil
pickup.effect: Unlocks a stealth cloak that reduces enemy detection by 50%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Harpy, the ground cracks open, revealing a glowing altar leading to the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Jaguar Guardian (mini-boss)
enemy.weakness: The Jaguar's armor is vulnerable to the Ember Knife (from the first encounter) when it is in a daze.

pickup.name: Jungle Bloom
pickup.effect: Unlocks the 'Jungle Stance' ability, granting +25% movement speed and +15% dodge chance for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: The Jaguar's defeat causes the chamber to collapse, forcing the player into a final escape route that leads directly to the boss.

boss.name: The Jaguar Guardian
boss.weakness: The Jaguar's armor is vulnerable to the Ember Knife (from the first encounter) when it is in a daze.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting its weakness

level.objective: Navigate the jungle and defeat The Jaguar Guardian using the pickups and weaknesses discovered along the way.
level.reward: Jungle Amulet (grants +15% damage against jungle enemies, +5% movement speed, permanent)

level.theme: A peaceful yet mysterious jungle filled with ancient secrets and guardian creatures
level.setting: A lush, serene jungle with glowing flora and mist-covered pathways

enemy.name: Rapid Viper
enemy.weakness: The player's primary weapon, the 'Warden's Longbow'

pickup.name: Stormbreaker
pickup.effect: Unlocks the 'Stormbreaker' pickaxe

encounters.trigger: Destroying the vines reveals a hidden path to the next encounter

enemy.name: Shadow Jaguar
enemy.weakness: The 'Stormbreaker' pickaxe acquired in the previous encounter

pickup.name: Fungal Shield
pickup.effect: Increases player defense by 10%

encounters.trigger: Crossing the mudslide leads to the final encounter

enemy.name: Thornback Panther
enemy.weakness: The 'Fungal Shield' acquired in the previous encounter

pickup.name: Echo of the Storm
pickup.effect: Reveals the location of the Stormclaw boss

encounters.trigger: Surviving the quicksand triggers the arrival of the Stormclaw boss

boss.name: Stormclaw
boss.weakness: The 'Stormbreaker' pickaxe acquired from the first encounter

level.objective: Navigate the jungle and defeat the Stormclaw boss by strategically using the pickups and your weapon
level.reward: Chest containing 500 gold, a rare jungle amulet, and a permanent +5% damage boost to the Warden's Longbow

level.setting: A cursed jungle where ancient spirits and corrupted beasts roam. The trees are twisted, the air is heavy with sorrow, and the jungle seems to watch the player's every move.

enemy.name: Shadowed Panther
enemy.weakness: Soulfire Dagger

encounters.hazard: The forest is thick with mist, reducing visibility and movement speed by 30%.

pickup.name: Heartstone
pickup.effect: Restores 50 health and grants a temporary boost to spell damage for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: As the necromancer defeats the panther, the mist clears, revealing an ancient altar glowing with dark energy.

enemy.name: Possessed Vulture
enemy.weakness: Cursed Feather (from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The wind is laced with toxic spores, dealing 10 damage every 5 seconds.

pickup.name: Cursed Feather
pickup.effect: Allows the necromancer to summon a spirit for 15 seconds, dealing damage to enemies in a radius.

encounters.trigger: As the vulture falls, the air becomes heavy with sorrow. The altar pulses with dark energy, summoning a spectral presence.

enemy.name: Corrupted Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Cursed Feather (from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable, occasionally causing the player to fall into hidden pits that deal 30 damage.

pickup.name: Spirit's Blessing
pickup.effect: Increases the power of all necromancer spells by 25% for the remainder of the level.

encounters.trigger: The corrupted jaguar roars, awakening the Vengeful Jaguar Spirit, who rises from the altar in a storm of shadows.

boss.name: Vengeful Jaguar Spirit
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the spirit by using the Heartstone from the first encounter.

level.objective: Navigate through the haunted jungle, defeat three corrupted creatures, and use the Heartstone to defeat the Vengeful Jaguar Spirit.
level.reward: Unlocks the 'Jungle Necromancer' title and grants 100 experience points.

level.theme: Whimsical and enchanting, with quirky characters and playful dangers.
level.setting: A vibrant, magical jungle filled with glowing plants, talking animals, and ancient ruins.

enemy.name: Moss Snail
enemy.weakness: Acid Flask (player's starting weapon)

pickup.name: Bloom Bloom Extract
pickup.effect: Restores 50% HP and grants a temporary immunity to poison

encounters.trigger: Player defeats the Moss Snail, which releases a cloud of spores. When the player steps through the spores, the path ahead opens up, revealing the second encounter.

enemy.name: Sapphire Serpent
enemy.weakness: Bloom Bloom Extract (pickup from first encounter)

pickup.name: Fermented Fern
pickup.effect: Increases alchemy crafting speed by 20%

encounters.trigger: After the player uses the Bloom Bloom Extract on the Serpent, the ground beneath the bridge begins to tremble, revealing a hidden path that leads to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Emerald Golem
enemy.weakness: Bloom Bloom Extract (pickup from first encounter)

pickup.name: Cooling Stone
pickup.effect: Grants temporary fire resistance

encounters.trigger: The player enters the chasm, and the Golem awakens. The fight begins only after the player uses the Bloom Bloom Extract on it.

boss.name: The Emerald Golem
boss.weakness: Bloom Bloom Extract (obtained from the first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Golem with the Bloom Bloom Extract.

level.objective: Retrieve the Bloom Bloom Extract from the first encounter and use it to defeat the final boss.
level.reward: Alchemy Mastery Token (unlocks a new alchemy recipe)

level.theme: The jungle is alive with echoes of the past and shadows of the future, and the player must navigate through its shifting reality to uncover the truth.
level.setting: A dense, ancient jungle filled with glowing bioluminescent plants, ghostly whispers, and time-warped landscapes that shift unpredictably.

enemy.name: Echo Stalker
enemy.weakness: Chronomancer's Time Anchor

pickup.name: Chrono Lens (Fragment)
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Time Anchor ability

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Echo Stalker, the Time Distortion Field begins to destabilize, revealing a hidden path leading deeper into the jungle.

enemy.name: Loopwraith
enemy.weakness: Chrono Lens (Fragment)

pickup.name: Echo Crystal
pickup.effect: Enhances the Chrono Lens (Fragment) into the full Chrono Lens

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Time Loop Trap with the Chrono Lens (Fragment) causes a temporal rift to open, revealing the path to the Timeless Warden’s lair.

enemy.name: Time Shaper
enemy.weakness: Chrono Lens

pickup.name: Chrono Sigil
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invulnerability during the boss fight

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Time Shaper with the Chrono Lens clears the path to the final chamber, where the Timeless Warden awaits.

boss.name: The Timeless Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Timeless Warden by destroying the Chrono Core using the Chrono Lens collected during the encounters.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the jungle and destroy the Timeless Warden, a guardian of time corrupted by the jungle’s eerie energy.
level.reward: Chrono Crown (boosts all time-based abilities by 20%)

level.theme: Desolation, survival, and primal rage. The jungle feels abandoned, yet it pulses with ancient malevolence.
level.setting: A desolate jungle with overgrown ruins, toxic fog, and broken pathways. The air is thick with the scent of decay and distant howls echo through the trees.

enemy.name: Stalked Panther
enemy.weakness: Player's primary weapon

pickup.name: Feral Rage Crystalline
pickup.effect: Increases berserker rage duration by 30%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Stalked Panther to reveal the path to the Viper's Nest.

enemy.name: Viper
enemy.weakness: Viper Fang Amulet (not yet obtainable, but triggers pickup)

pickup.name: Viper Fang Amulet
pickup.effect: Inflicts critical damage to boss when equipped

encounters.trigger: Collect the Viper Fang Amulet to weaken the boss in the final fight.

enemy.name: Mangrove Spirit
enemy.weakness: Feral Rage Crystalline

pickup.name: Berserker's Mark
pickup.effect: Increases berserker melee damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Mangrove Spirit to unlock the path to the boss.

boss.name: The Hollow Jaguar
boss.weakness: Viper Fang Amulet (obtained from the Viper's Nest encounter)

level.objective: Survive the jungle and defeat The Hollow Jaguar.
